description: This file is a Lua source file containing tests and usage examples for the UTF-8 library. It asserts the correctness of UTF-8 encoding, decoding, and error handling functions, including codepoint processing, string length, offsets, and special Unicode character handling.

methods.name: checkerror
methods.description: Helper function to run a function and assert that it raises an expected error message.

methods.name: len
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string in terms of Unicode codepoints, ignoring UTF-8 continuation bytes.

methods.name: checksyntax
methods.description: Constructs a string from codepoints and verifies that loading and executing that string produces the expected string.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Runs a comprehensive suite of assertions on a string and its corresponding codepoints, verifying utf8 functions, offsets, lengths, and error handling.

methods.name: invalid
methods.description: Checks that invalid UTF-8 sequences produce the expected errors.
